text:
andrew (sales): Aurora Bank agreed to a short pilot. They need low-latency bi-directional WS streaming, deterministic tool/function calls for payment authorization, and structured CSV output for their ledger. SSO via Okta, customer KMS, EU-only processing. Need pricing for a 6-week pilot and list of blockers. Sync 08:30 CET tomorrow.

nina (se): Clarify: they want server push for realtime status and immediate ACKs for authorizations. Also want example schema for toolcall responses.

kai (eng-runtime): Use /v1/ws/connect with subprotocol redwood.v1. Recommend ACK frame `{"type":"ack","id":"<msg-id>"}` and final frame `{"type":"done","id":"<msg-id>","checksum":"sha256"}` for truncation detection. For EU pinning, Dedicated ring needed (affects cost).

maya (devex): I'll assemble a tiny repo with Node and Python WS clients plus a CSV adapter (fields: tx_id,timestamp,acct,amt,currency,status). Will include a client state machine for fragments and checksum verification.

tom (security): Hosted supports envelope encryption with CMK via KMS integration; Dedicated/Private supports customer-managed KMS. Need their security questionnaire (SOC/SAML/Pen test). Also flag PCI considerations if card data in scopes.

ci-bot (deploy-bot): Pilot profile `pilot/aurora` deployment queued (ci/4789).

andrew (sales): Procurement wants a single-page estimate: pilot committed cost and conversion path to Dedicated. Can we provide conservative/optimized numbers by EOD?

kai (eng-runtime): I'll produce two scenarios: conservative (no KV cache, minimal batching) and optimized (KV cache + batching + quantized model for non-critical calls). Will include resource and latency assumptions for 30 QPS.

nina (se): I'll open SSO ticket and capture Okta metadata step. Also will own demo script during sync.

andrew (sales): Great, please tag this thread when docs are up. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
